transcript.text: Can you describe the methodology and findings of your final-year project on UPI usage among shoppers in Lucknow markets?

I completed my BCom in Lucknow this year. My final project was a survey of 40 shoppers about how they use UPI for small purchases. Most said they use it for amounts below a few hundred rupees but still carry cash for vegetable vendors. I have no work experience yet. I want to do an MBA because I have studied accounts but have not learned how a financial company chooses its customers.

feedback.summary: The candidate provided a basic overview of their final-year project on UPI usage and linked their academic background to their career ambitions in banking and financial services. They displayed enthusiasm and a willingness to learn, with some reflection on the project's insights. However, their answers lacked specific details about their personal contributions, challenges faced, and analytical depth regarding the survey results. There was also a missed opportunity to connect the project learnings more concretely to their future goals. The candidate's off-topic response suggests a need for more focused communication in interviews.

strengths.observation: The candidate clearly described the main focus and scope of their final-year project, establishing solid context about their academic work and interests.

strengths.quote: I want to do an MBA because I have studied accounts but have not learned how a financial company chooses its customers
strengths.observation: The candidate articulated a clear motivation for pursuing an MBA linked to their background and career aspirations in financial services.

improvements.quote: I am a quick learner and a good communicator. I believe in teamwork and hard work, and I am passionate about learning new things every day
improvements.observation: The candidate answered a question about project challenges with a generic personal statement unrelated to the question asked.
improvements.suggestion: Practice answering questions directly by describing specific challenges faced during a project, for example, explaining one difficulty encountered during survey data collection or Excel tabulation and how you addressed it.

improvements.quote: The survey results were very interesting and gave many insights about consumer behaviour in the digital era
improvements.observation: The candidate did not specify which insights were interesting or demonstrate analytical thinking about the findings.
improvements.suggestion: Practice summarizing two or three key insights from a project or study, highlighting why they mattered and what you learned from them to show deeper understanding and reflection.

improvements.quote: I don't know how many of the 40 shoppers were women. I did not note down gender separately in my sheet
improvements.observation: The candidate showed a gap in project design and data collection, lacking attention to demographic details relevant to data analysis.
improvements.suggestion: Review the importance of data categorization by practicing designing a small survey that includes demographic variables and then explain how these variables can affect analysis and interpretations.

feedback.next_exercise: Retell your final-year project in 60 seconds, highlighting the exact steps you took during data collection and analysis, a specific challenge you faced, how you overcame it, and what key insight you took away relevant to your career goals in financial services.
